rules.description: RSA key size < 3072 bits. Vulnerable to classical factoring and rapid decryption by CRQCs using Shor's algorithm.
rules.remediation: Upgrade key size to 3072 or 4096 bits, or migrate to ML-DSA/ML-KEM.

rules.description: MD5 or SHA-1 hashing algorithm is cryptographically broken.
rules.remediation: Use SHA-256, SHA-3, or SLH-DSA for secure signing/hashing.

rules.description: AES in ECB mode does not provide message confidentiality across blocks.
rules.remediation: Switch to GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) or CBC with secure random IV.

rules.description: Using weak algorithms (DES, RC4) or ECB padding modes.
rules.remediation: Migrate to aes-256-gcm or post-quantum alternatives.

rules.description: MD5 and SHA-1 hashes are vulnerable to collision attacks.

rules.remediation: Generate RSA keys with size >= 3072 bits or transition to ML-DSA.

rules.description: Explicit TLS 1.0 or TLS 1.1 protocol version selected.
rules.remediation: Enforce tls.VersionTLS13 as the minimum TLS version.
Increase RSA key size to at least 3072 bits.

rules.description: DES, RC4, or ECB modes are highly insecure.
rules.remediation: Upgrade cipher string to AES/GCM/NoPadding or similar.

rules.description: Generating classical RSA key size < 3072 bits using OpenSSL.
rules.remediation: Use key sizes of 3072+ or integrate ML-KEM via OpenSSL 3.5+.

rules.description: PEM-encoded private key structure detected in source code.
rules.remediation: Remove hardcoded cryptographic credentials. Use secret managers.
